[[Verdanturf Town]] }} '''Mind-Boggling with Medicham''' (Japanese: '''VS チャーレム''' ''VS {{tt|Charem|Medicham}}''), titled '''VS Medicham''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 217th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 37th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Contest at Verdanturf Town''' (Japanese: '''シダケのコンテスト''' ''{{tt|Shidake|Verdanturf}} Contest'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Verdanturf Contest''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} At the [[Desert Ruins]], [[Team Magma]] lies inside of their base. While [[Tabitha]] reveals to [[Maxie]] that he failed to stop the death of [[Mt. Chimney]], [[Blaise]] modifies the [[Scanner]], and [[Courtney]] goes to look for a certain treasure (later revealed to be the [[Red Orb]]). Before Courtney leaves, Maxie has her use the lighter to show him images about what had happened at the [[Abandoned Ship]]. After she leaves, Maxie decides that it is time for him to go out as well. In [[Verdanturf Town]], Ruby finally is able to start his first [[Hoenn]] {{pkmn|Contest}}. With [[Kiki]], he easily beats the Normal Rank {{OBP|Cute|condition}} Contest. Later, a crowd gathers to look at Ruby's victories in the {{OBP|Cool|condition}} and Cute Contests with [[Nana]] and Kiki, respectively. Upstairs, Ruby prepares a sweater for [[Mumu]], but is still struggling from the injuries in his battle with {{adv|Norman}}. Although injured, Ruby is too happy about his acquisition of a [[Contest Pass]] to care and assigns Contest categories to his team. Kiki is assigned Cute Contests, Nana is assigned Cool Contests, Mumu is assigned {{OBP|Tough|condition}} Contests, and the two new members, [[Feefee]] and Fofo, are assigned {{OBP|Beautiful|condition|Beauty}} and {{OBP|Clever|condition|Smart}} Contests, respectively. As Ruby takes pictures of his team, [[Gabby and Ty]] come in to interview him for his recent Contest victories. Although he would love to be on TV, Ruby refuses as he does not want himself to be shown as a kidnap victim and runs off when the Beauty Contest begins. Ty feels bad for giving Ruby the {{p|Castform}} belonging to [[Mr. Stone]], along with the fact that they should be reporting on the submarine incident instead of Ruby. Gabby replies that they should keep following Ruby, as she has a good feeling about him. Before the next Contest starts, the announcer explains how the Contest system works. If one wins a Contest in Verdanturf Town, they can challenge a Contest of a higher rank in [[Fallarbor Town]], [[Slateport City]], and [[Lilycove City]], respectively. After explaining the two parts of a Contest, the announcer starts the Normal Rank Beauty Contest. In the Contest, Ruby uses Feefee, which confuses the audience at his choice of Pokémon. In his head, Ruby recalls learning that a beautiful Pokémon can win a Contest on their own, but if Ruby can win the Contest with Feefee, he can surprise everyone. Ruby has Feefee use {{m|Water Pulse}}, which gets applause from the audience. As the audience claps, Ruby notices what appears to be {{adv|Wally}} in the crowd. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} obtains a [[Contest Pass]] and enters a [[Pokémon Contest]]. * Ruby wins the [[Rank (Contest)|Normal Rank]] {{OBP|Cute|condition}}ness and {{OBP|Cool|condition}}ness Contests with [[Kiki]] and [[Nana]], respectively. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Contest announcer]] * [[Wanda]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Medicham}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * [[Maxie]] * [[Blaise]]/{{tt|Mack|Chuang Yi}} * [[Courtney]]/{{tt|Marge|Chuang Yi}} * [[Tabitha]]/{{tt|Mitch|Chuang Yi}} * [[Gabby and Ty]]/{{tt|Maryann and Tyler|Chuang Yi}} * [[Mr. Stone]] (flashback) * [[Wanda]]/{{tt|Wallene|Chuang Yi}} * [[Chairtarō]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mightyena}} ([[Nana]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Delcatty}} ([[Kiki]]/{{tt|Coco|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Marshtomp}} ([[Mumu]]/{{tt|Zuzu|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Feebas}} ([[Feefee]]/{{tt|Mimi|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo]]/{{tt|Popo|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Medicham}} (Meddy; {{pkmn|Coordinator|Cody}}'s) * {{p|Altaria}} (Alta; {{pkmn|Coordinator|Aoi}}'s) * {{p|Camerupt}} (Erwin; {{pkmn|Coordinator|Hillary}}'s) * {{p|Kadabra}} ({{pkmn|Coordinator}}'s) * {{p|Barboach}} ({{pkmn|Coordinator}}'s) * {{p|Pelipper}} ({{pkmn|Coordinator}}'s) * {{p|Tropius}} ({{pkmn|Coordinator}}'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} translation, {{adv|Ruby}} says [[Nana]] is responsible for the [[Beautiful (condition)|Beautiful]] [[Contest condition]] instead of [[Cool (condition)|Cool]]. ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | '''Title''' {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 恰雷姆|VS Medicham}} |cs=Vs.
